name: Emerging Topics in Geotechnical Engineering
description: This course evolves with the need for the hour focusing on the new and latest state-of-the-art developments in the field of the broad spectrum of geotechnical and geoenvironmental engineering. The course will also focus on new variations of geotechnical and geoenvironmental engineering in diverse forms that are being developed worldwide.
